messages.subject: Errors and warnings for 1.csv.RData$message [1] "only 0's may be mixed with negative subscripts"
parts:
Hello,

After a few weeks of working through the manual and formatting our files correctly for the sleep log, we were able to run 39 subjects through GGIR. (Thank you so much for this valuable code for the field!!). However, when we went to translate the similar code to another set of data collected the exact same way, we get this error in step 5 for about 75% of our subjects:

Errors and warnings for Subject1.RData$message
[1] "only 0's may be mixed with negative subscripts"

$call
ts$diur[s0:(s1 - 1)] <- 1



Looking through the Part5 Master code I can't quite source where this error is coming from to try and solve. Any thoughts?

I would also be happy to send the data to recreate the errors, yet at this point I am still so new to the code, it would be unclear which data would be most useful to attached send with this issue. 

Thanks in advance! 
Megan Herting
